statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let major := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n).indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let I := fun (n:ℕ) (a b:ℕ→ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => S n a u*S n b u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → (∃ N₁ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N₁ ≤ n → Even n → c * (n : ℝ) ≤ (major n).re) → (∃ N₂ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N₂ ≤ n → Even n → -(c * (n : ℝ) / 2) ≤ (I n (high n) (high n)).re) → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → Even n → c * (n : ℝ) / 4 ≤ Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun p => w p * w (n - p))

plain_statement.en: New route · High-segment minor arcs · MA-7009 · Relative major-arc bulk interface for eventual Goldbach

brief.zh: 保持原冻结命题的素数权、弧宽与立方根截断：把主弧下界 c*n 与高高项相对下界 -(c/2)*n 合并，用 Parseval 吸收低低与两倍低高次线性误差，交付 R(n) ≥ (c/4)*n。
brief.en: Keep the frozen prime weight, arc radius, and cube-root cutoff: combine a major-arc floor c*n with a relative high-high lower bound -(c/2)*n via Parseval low-low/low-high bounds to obtain R(n) ≥ (c/4)*n.
